mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.user_id, e.name, e.display_name, e.created_at FROM webauthn_user_entity e JOIN app_user u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
SELECT user_id FROM webauthn_user_entity WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO webauthn_user_entity (id, user_id, name, display_name) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{displayName})
mapper.update: UPDATE webauthn_user_entity SET name = #{name}, display_name = #{displayName} WHERE id = #{id}
